default.title: Arrow Up Guide
default.subtitle: Boost your personal momentum and achieve daily clarity.
default.tip1Desc: Use the bottom bar to switch between Todos, Journals, Skills, Rules, and Missions.
default.tip2Desc: All data stays cached locally so you can continue uninterrupted even with no connection.
default.tip3Desc: Small consistent actions done every single day compound into life-changing results.

todos.title: Todos & Habits Guide
todos.subtitle: Master your daily schedule and build consistent momentum.
todos.tip1Desc: Track active actions and mark them as done when finished. Completed tasks help review your day.
todos.tip2Desc: Filter between Todo, In-Progress, and Done tabs to maintain sharp focus on immediate priorities.
todos.tip3Desc: Tap the '+' button to schedule new tasks with deadlines, time estimates, and life area tags.

todosNew.title: New Todo Guide
todosNew.subtitle: Create actionable, focused tasks for your day.
todosNew.tip1Desc: Start titles with active verbs (e.g. 'Read 20 pages' or 'Ship v1 release') for mental clarity.
todosNew.tip2Desc: Assign target dates and times to prevent procrastination and structure your day.
todosNew.tip3Desc: Tag tasks with Work, Sport, or Personal domains to maintain balanced daily effort.

journals.title: Daily Journals Guide
journals.subtitle: Reflect on thoughts, learnings, and personal growth.
journals.tip1Desc: Writing down observations and daily wins clears cognitive clutter and increases gratitude.
journals.tip2Desc: Organize entries by category (Ideas, Gratitude, Retrospectives) for easy retrieval.
journals.tip3Desc: Revisiting past journal notes reveals patterns in your decision-making and emotional states.

journalsNew.title: New Journal Entry Guide
journalsNew.subtitle: Capture your reflections, insights, and moments of gratitude.
journalsNew.tip1Desc: Write authentic notes about what worked today, lessons learned, and ideas for tomorrow.
journalsNew.tip2Desc: Attach relevant categories or create new ones to keep your personal journal organized.
journalsNew.tip3Desc: Journaling either first thing in the morning or right before sleep yields the highest clarity.

journalsCategories.title: Journal Categories Guide
journalsCategories.subtitle: Structure and categorize your reflective notes.
journalsCategories.tip1Desc: Group journal entries under meaningful labels like Personal, Career, Health, or Reading.
journalsCategories.tip2Desc: Rename or delete obsolete categories anytime to maintain a streamlined structure.
journalsCategories.tip3Desc: Categories let you instantly filter past entries to review specific aspects of your life.

skills.title: Skills Mastery Guide
skills.subtitle: Track and level up your abilities systematically.
skills.tip1Desc: Monitor competency levels from novice to expert across multiple life domains.
skills.tip2Desc: Regular, focused 20-minute practice sessions outperform sporadic hours of unfocused practice.
skills.tip3Desc: Set measurable achievements for each skill so you can tangibly observe your progress.

skillsNew.title: New Skill Guide
skillsNew.subtitle: Define a capability you want to acquire or sharpen.
skillsNew.tip1Desc: Specify what mastering this skill looks like (e.g., 'TypeScript Mastery' or 'Swimming Sprint').
skillsNew.tip2Desc: Connect skills to relevant life areas like Work or Sport to balance your development.
skillsNew.tip3Desc: Break down learning into manageable daily or weekly habits to guarantee consistency.

skillsCategories.title: Skill Categories Guide
skillsCategories.subtitle: Organize competencies into thematic growth tracks.
skillsCategories.tip1Desc: Group skills into buckets like Technical, Communication, Physical Health, or Leadership.
skillsCategories.tip2Desc: Aim for a well-rounded skill portfolio spanning both hard technical and soft interpersonal skills.
skillsCategories.tip3Desc: Keep category names short and direct for effortless scanning on mobile screens.

rules.title: Life Rules & Principles Guide
rules.subtitle: Define guardrails and personal non-negotiables.
rules.tip1Desc: Rules serve as automated decision-making filters when fatigue or distraction strikes.
rules.tip2Desc: Establish boundary rules for sleep, screen time, physical health, and personal ethics.
rules.tip3Desc: Regularly revisit your rules. Keep principles that serve you and refine ones that don't.

rulesNew.title: New Rule Guide
rulesNew.subtitle: Draft a clear, personal guideline for your conduct.
rulesNew.tip1Desc: Formulate short, unambiguous principles (e.g., 'No screens after 11 PM', 'Walk 8k steps').
rulesNew.tip2Desc: Ensure every rule directly reinforces an outcome or identity you truly desire.
rulesNew.tip3Desc: Start with a few sacred non-negotiable rules before introducing more complex routines.

missions.title: Missions & Goals Guide
missions.subtitle: Execute high-impact strategic initiatives and milestones.
missions.tip1Desc: Missions are your highest-leverage goals that transform your life over weeks or months.
missions.tip2Desc: Decompose intimidating goals into tangible, verifiable milestone checkpoints.
missions.tip3Desc: Monitor deadline targets and celebrate each completed milestone along the journey.

missionsNew.title: New Mission Guide
missionsNew.subtitle: Launch a targeted strategic initiative with defined targets.
missionsNew.tip1Desc: State exactly what success looks like upon completing this mission.
missionsNew.tip2Desc: Set reasonable deadline targets to maintain positive urgency without burnout.
missionsNew.tip3Desc: Schedule daily todos and habits that directly contribute to achieving this mission.

profile.title: Profile & Settings Guide
profile.subtitle: Personalize your experience and manage preferences.
profile.tip1Desc: Switch between English and Persian, or Dark and Light themes with instant persistence.
profile.tip2Desc: Review high-level summaries of all your recorded todos, journals, skills, and missions.
profile.tip3Desc: Easily manage your login session or log out whenever you need.

search.title: Search Guide
search.subtitle: Find tasks, journals, and skills instantly.
search.tip1Desc: Type keywords to quickly locate items across all your life modules.
search.tip2Desc: Use titles or categories to narrow down results effortlessly.
search.tip3Desc: Search indexes your tasks, journal entries, and skills in one unified view.
